Name: The Return of Immersive Sprinklers (obsolete)
Author: lucaskfreitas
Description:

[/b][/size][size=4]Instead, check the newer mod done by the original author: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44338]Immersive Sprinklers and Scarecrows[/url][/size]


[size=5][b]Disclaimer[/b][/size]

This project is a Fork of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15239]Immersive Sprinklers[/url], a Stardew Valley mod originally from aedenthorn.

The purpose of this fork is basically to make it compatible with version 1.6 of SV, which was released on March 19, 2024.

[b][i]Warning: this mod is still at its early stages, so some bugs might still exist.[/i][/b]

If you like this mod and would like to make a donation to support it, you can do so at [url=https://ko-fi.com/lucaskfreitas]ko-fi[/url]﻿. I really appreciate support of any kind!


[size=4][b]Also check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20701]The Return of Immersive Scarecrows[/url].


[size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size][/b][/size]

With this mod you can place any of the three types of sprinkler directly onto tilled soil tiles. The sprinkler will be placed on the corner closest to the mouse cursor and water all crops surrounding it.

By default:

[list]
[*][b]Ordinary sprinklers[/b] will water all [b]four[/b] surrounding tiles.[/*]
[*][b]Quality sprinklers[/b] will water the [b]sixteen[/b] tiles surrounding the sprinkler.[/*]
[*][b]Iridium sprinklers[/b] will water the [b]thirty-six[/b] tiles surrounding the sprinkler.[/*]
[/list]
You can change the sprinkler radii for these or any custom sprinkler in the config.

Sprinklers can hold both an enricher and a pressure nozzle at the same time.

Sprinklers can be passed through by the farmer.

To see the sprinkler range (and current fertilizer in an enricher), hold down the show range key (default [b]Left Control[/b]) and hover over the sprinkler.

To remove an immersively-placed sprinkler, hover over it and press the pickup key (default [b]E[/b]).

You can manually activate a sprinkler by hovering over it and pressing the activate key (default [b]Enter[/b]).

You can change the sprinkler scale and opacity in the config.


[size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size]

Sprinklers are stored in the tilled soil object; the mod will prevent the destruction of the tilled soil containing the sprinkler.

Sprinkler radius will be affected by mods that change sprinkler radius or add sprinklers with custom radii. Modded sprinklers with different watering shapes or mechanics will not affect these sprinklers.


[size=5][b]Config[/b][/size]

You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/lucaskfreitas/ImmersiveSprinklers]https://github.com/lucaskfreitas/ImmersiveSprinklers[/url].
